$comment: Harness control allowlist (job 2026-11-06-harness-control-nick-node). The ONLY things bdnick, Nick or a Claude session can ask a PC to run. Each action is a name plus the exact argv the PC runs from its own checkout; nothing in a request can add to or change argv. keepEnv names the env keys that one action needs passed through (never HARNESS_CONTROL_KEY); every other harness key is stripped from children. 'node' as argv[0] means the poller's own node binary. findingsExitCodes are exit codes meaning 'ran fine and reported problems' (FINDINGS, not FAILED). needsGo=true (or a missing needsGo) is refused by every door until an approval path ships. v1 holds read-only actions only: nothing writes outside the repo or restarts anything. Server mirror: apps/statenour/lib/services/harness-control.ts HARNESS_ACTIONS (tests/services/harness-control.test.ts fails if the two drift). Poller: scripts/agent-os/harness-poll.mjs.

pc-status.summary: Free RAM, uptime, the heavy slot, the last harness-snapshot and harness-poll failures on this PC.

harness-snapshot-now.summary: Send this PC's read-only harness snapshot now instead of waiting for the 5-minute tick.

bootstrap-check.summary: Report what the machine bootstrap would change on this PC; changes nothing (--check). Exit 1 means it found drift.

health-line.summary: The [health] line: code graph and its server, scheduled tasks, hooks, CLIs. Read-only; it exits 0 even when it lists problems, so read the output.
